title: Summit Flyer Rate on the Reinstatement Fee — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Summit benefit term.** The reinstatement-fee member rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers depends on the customer's Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program and on the flight accruals posted to the Summit account:

- **0.70** for a Summit Gold member with at least 4 flight accruals posted to the Summit account in the last 12 calendar months;
- **0.85** for a Summit Silver member with at least 4 such flight accruals;
- **1** for every other customer.

**Window.** A reinstatement-fee window of the last so many calendar months holds the entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date the reinstatement fee is worked out, so it rolls back from that date and is not a count of completed calendar months.

## Tier and flight accruals in combination

| Summit tier | Flight accruals in the last 12 calendar months | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Gold | 4 or more | 0.70 |
| Summit Gold | 3 or fewer | 1 |
| Summit Silver | 4 or more | 0.85 |
| Summit Silver | 3 or fewer | 1 |
| Summit Member, Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond, Summit Chairman, or no Summit membership | any number | 1 |

## Window boundary (hypothetical, fee worked out on 20 May 2026)

| Posting date of a flight accrual | Whole calendar months before 20 May 2026 | Inside the window |
|---|---|---|
| 21 May 2025 | 11 | yes |
| 20 May 2025 | 12 | no |

A Summit Gold member with flight accruals posted on 21 May 2025, 3 August 2025, 9 January 2026 and 2 April 2026 has 4 in the window, so the rate is 0.70. If the first accrual had been posted on 20 May 2025 there would be 3 in the window, and the rate would be 1.
